tools.name: about_me
tools.description: Get factual information about Surendran Balachandran: role as VP of AI-Led Growth at Atlan, founding team history, previous leadership at Change.org India and IYCN, marathon running, published essays, and operating philosophy.

tools.name: book_meeting
tools.description: Book a meeting with Surendran via Cal.com. Call with no arguments to fetch real open slots. Pass slot_start, attendee name, and email to confirm the booking directly on Cal.com.

slot_start.description: Chosen slot ISO timestamp (e.g. "2026-09-05T14:00:00.000+05:30"). If omitted, available slots will be fetched.

name.description: Attendee full name (required when booking a slot).

email.description: Attendee email address (required when booking a slot).

days_ahead.description: Number of days ahead to search for open slots (1-14).

tools.name: contact_me
tools.description: Get contact information to connect with Surendran: email (contact@surendranb.com), LinkedIn, X (@surendranb), and GitHub. Can prepare a pre-filled mailto draft link.

tools.name: explore_projects
tools.description: Search and inspect Surendran's portfolio of 23+ AI products, MCP servers, and studio labs on builditwithai.xyz with GitHub repositories and CLI install commands (uvx).
